tolerance.note: numbers relative 1e-6 (7 s.f.), zero compared abs 1e-9; booleans exact; the method's DISCRETE output is the expected value (not the exact solution, which is reported separately); errors compared exactly as {error: schema class, reason: lower_snake_case code} (KAT_SCHEMA 17:46)

convention: ode_solve: explicit Euler or classical RK4, fixed step h, t starts at 0, fixed ODE list {decay: y'=lam y; logistic: y'=r y(1-y/K); t_minus_y: y'=t-y}; returns the numerical y, the exact solution at t=n h and abs_error=|y-exact|. convergence_order: errors[] for each h on y'=lam y, y(0)=1, and observed_order = the scalar p=log(e_k/e_(k+1))/log(h_k/h_(k+1)) for the LAST pair (FIT Site 20:29). stability: amplification |R(z)| for z=h lam on the real axis; Euler R=1+z, RK4 R=1+z+z^2/2+z^3/6+z^4/24; stable means |R|<=1 (boundary counts as stable). upwind_advect: first-order upwind for u_t+a u_x=0, a>0, periodic boundary, Courant C=a dt/dx, u_j^(n+1)=u_j-C(u_j-u_(j-1)); bounded = stays within the initial min/max. grid_convergence: observed order and Richardson extrapolation. At most one scalar ODE or one 2-state system, or 100 advection cells; Euler, RK4 and upwind only (scope cap). The nonlinear pendulum member belongs to FIT Printers and is not in this file.
oracle: script-verified (textbook formulae); ChatGPT Chat cross-check pending. Expected values from explicit step loops following R. L. Burden & J. D. Faires, Numerical Analysis (textbook); E. Hairer & G. Wanner, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations II (textbook); R. J. LeVeque, Finite Difference Methods for Ordinary and Partial Differential Equations (textbook); W. E. Boyce & R. C. DiPrima, Elementary Differential Equations (textbook); P. J. Roache (1998), Verification of codes and calculations, AIAA J. 36:696 (Richardson extrapolation, observed order); recomputed independently from closed-form amplification factors R(z)^n, the closed-form Euler sum for y'=t-y, a numpy periodic upwind matrix power, numpy RK4 on arrays, and a base-10 / power-law fit for Richardson
